objectives: Shop for food with quantities and prices.
Say numbers to 1,000 and give ages and clock times.
Present close family members and where they live.
Describe today's weather and a simple forecast.

teacherNote.title: Plan one picnic, one detail at a time
teacherNote.body: This is a big lesson, so use one practical scene: plan a picnic, check the shopping, choose a time and look at the weather. Family is your main speaking task.

dialogue.title: A picnic plan
dialogue.instructions: Listen once for the day, time and weather. Then show the Swedish.

opening.questionIntro: Use the picnic conversation to check the time and the forecast.

recall.label: Hear the conversation
recall.description: Listen for the picnic time, shopping list and weather.

teach.label: Build it step by step
teach.description: Build quantities, numbers, family descriptions, times and weather reports.

hero.title: Ska vi ha picknick?
hero.lede: Make a shopping list and choose a time. Introduce your family, then invite a friend with all the details they need.

startLine.label: START WITH ONE LINE
startLine.fi: Vi träffas klockan två på lördag.
startLine.en: We are meeting at two on Saturday.
startLine.audioText: Vi träffas klockan två på lördag. Det blir soligt och varmt.

speakers.name: Elin
speakers.fi: Ska vi ha picknick på lördag?

hero.encounterLabel: Elin and Alex plan food and a meeting time for a picnic

recall.explanation: Elin says Vi börjar klockan två.
Elin says that it will be sunny and warm.

dialogue.speaker: Elin
dialogue.fi: Hej Alex! Ska vi ha picknick på lördag?
dialogue.en: Hi Alex! Shall we have a picnic on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.fi: Ja, gärna! Hur många personer kommer?
dialogue.en: Yes, gladly! How many people are coming?

dialogue.speaker: Elin
dialogue.fi: Sex personer. Min syster och hennes två barn kommer också.
dialogue.en: Six people. My sister and her two children are coming too.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.fi: Bra. Jag köper två påsar äpplen, ett kilo ost och tre flaskor juice.
dialogue.en: Good. I'll buy two bags of apples, one kilo of cheese and three bottles of juice.

dialogue.speaker: Elin
dialogue.fi: Köp också åtta korvar och en burk tomatsås, tack.
dialogue.en: Also buy eight sausages and a jar of tomato sauce, please.

dialogue.speaker: Elin
dialogue.fi: Vi börjar klockan två. Min syster kommer kvart över två.
dialogue.en: We start at two. My sister comes at quarter past two.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: What will the weather be like?

dialogue.speaker: Elin
dialogue.fi: Solen skiner och det blir varmt, ungefär tjugo grader.
dialogue.en: The sun will shine and it will be warm, about twenty degrees.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.fi: Toppen! I dag regnar det, men på lördag blir det picknick.
dialogue.en: Great! Today it is raining, but on Saturday there will be a picnic.

pages.title: Textbook page practice: Inköpslista
pages.intro: Peter's list turns the numbers one to twelve into useful food quantities.
pages.imageAlt: Textbook page 27, Inköpslista, with Peter's grocery list

lines.speaker: Peter
lines.fi: Peter är på en mataffär. Han ska laga middag ikväll så han köper ingredienser. Han måste också köpa saker som är slut. Här är hans lista:
lines.en: Peter is in a grocery shop. He will cook dinner tonight, so he buys ingredients. He must also buy things that have run out. Here is his list:

lines.speaker: Peter
lines.fi: en burk tomatsås, två kilo mjöl, tre paket mjölk, fyra hekto svamp
lines.en: one jar of tomato sauce, two kilos of flour, three cartons of milk, four hectograms of mushrooms

lines.speaker: Peter
lines.fi: fem hekto lök, sex bananer, sju hekto ost, åtta flaskor jus
lines.en: five hectograms of onions, six bananas, seven hectograms of cheese, eight bottles of juice

lines.speaker: Peter
lines.fi: nio korvar, tio toarullar, elva potatisar, tolv påsar godis
lines.en: nine sausages, ten toilet rolls, eleven potatoes, twelve bags of sweets

listenQuestions.prompt: How many bottles of juice are listed?
listenQuestions.explanation: The list says åtta flaskor jus.

naturalNotes.note: The source says på. In ordinary production, say i en mataffär for being inside a grocery shop.
For the drink, copy the standard spelling juice. Jus usually means meat juices or a sauce.
Toarullar is the informal word for toilet rolls, not bread rolls.

chunks: Han måste också köpa saker som är slut.

pages.title: Textbook page practice: Familjen
pages.intro: Keep this large textbook family inside the source step. Use its ages and relationship words, not its drama.
pages.imageAlt: Textbook page 28, Familjen, describing several relatives and their ages
recallCues: Peter and Maria's family and ages.
Lena and Andreas's sons and grandparents.

lines.speaker: Berättare
lines.fi: Peter och Maria är gifta och har två döttrar, Sara och Jenny. De var sambo i många år men de gifte sig för åtta år sedan. Peter är 45 (fyrtiofem) år gammal och Maria är 42 (fyrtiotvå). Sara är 15 (femton) och Jenny är 9 år.
lines.en: Peter and Maria are married and have two daughters, Sara and Jenny. They lived together for many years but married eight years ago. Peter is 45 and Maria is 42. Sara is 15 and Jenny is 9.

lines.speaker: Berättare
lines.fi: Lena och Andreas har två söner, Nils och Jonas, som går i grundskolan. Andreas föräldrar är deras farmor och farfar. Lenas föräldrar är deras mormor och morfar. De är mycket gamla, ungefär 70 (sjuttio) år.
lines.en: Lena and Andreas have two sons who attend comprehensive school. Andreas's parents are their paternal grandparents; Lena's are their maternal grandparents. They are about 70.

lines.speaker: Berättare
lines.fi: Sofias mamma, Ingrid, är singel.
lines.en: Sofia's mother, Ingrid, is single.

lines.speaker: Berättare
lines.fi: Nora har inga barn för hon är ung. Hon är 32 (trettiotvå) år. Dessutom gillar hon att vara barnfri.
lines.en: Nora has no children because she is young. She is 32. In addition, she likes being child-free.

listenQuestions.prompt: Who are Andreas's parents to the boys?
listenQuestions.explanation: A father's parents are farmor and farfar.

naturalNotes.note: The source uses singular sambo after de. In your own standard Swedish, use plural sambor.

chunks: Andreas föräldrar är deras farmor och farfar
Andreas föräldrar är deras farmor och farfar.

pages.title: Textbook page practice: Jag blev kär i…
pages.intro: Use the clock and frequency language. Jonas's classmate remains an unnamed source character.
pages.imageAlt: Textbook page 30 with clock expressions and a paragraph about frequency
recallCues: Ten past five, quarter past five and half past five.
Quarter to and five to six.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.fi: Klockan är fem prick, jag tänker på henne.
lines.en: It is exactly five; I think of her.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.fi: Tio över fem tänker jag på henne. Kvart över fem tänker jag på henne. Halv sex tänker jag på henne.
lines.en: At ten past five, quarter past five and half past five, I think of her.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.fi: Kvart i sex tänker jag på henne. Fem i sex tänker jag på henne.
lines.en: At quarter to six I think of her. At five to six I think of her.

lines.speaker: Berättare
lines.fi: Jonas blev kär i en skolkamrat. Han tänker på henne hela tiden. Han är alltid glad när han tänker på henne. Han tittar ofta på henne i klassrummet. Ibland köper han choklad till henne. Hon märker det ibland. De träffas sällan under sommarlovet. Hon messar aldrig på sociala medier.
lines.en: Jonas fell in love with a classmate. He thinks of her all the time. He is always happy when he thinks of her. He often looks at her in the classroom. Sometimes he buys her chocolate. She sometimes notices it. They rarely meet during summer break. She never messages on social media.

listenQuestions.explanation: Swedish counts toward the next hour: halv sex is 5:30.

listenQuestions.prompt: How often does she message on social media?

naturalNotes.note: Say the full model while learning. Swedish halv sex means halfway toward six: 5:30.

chunks: Hon messar aldrig på sociala medier.

hunt.title: Find the coloured frequency words.
hunt.instructions: Put the frequency words from most often to least often.

pages.intro: This picture wheel gives ten weather words and phrases.
pages.imageAlt: Textbook page 31 with a wheel of weather expressions

lines.speaker: Henrik
lines.fi: Det åskar. Växlande molnighet.
lines.en: There is thunder. Variable cloudiness.

lines.speaker: Henrik
lines.fi: Vinden blåser. Der är dimma.

lines.speaker: Henrik

lines.en: It is cloudy. It is raining. A rainbow.

listenQuestions.explanation: Det regnar means it is raining.
Mulet is a dark, fully overcast sky.

naturalNotes.note: This is a natural way to ask people elsewhere what their weather is like.
The page has a typo: der should be det.
The page gives a noun label. This is a full sentence: there is a rainbow.

chunks: Det snöar. Det är mulet. Solen skiner.

hunt.title: Find weather built with det and weather built with a noun.
hunt.instructions: Notice Det regnar but Solen skiner and Vinden blåser.

sections.title: Food and quantities
body: Put a container or weight before food: en burk tomatsås, en påse godis, ett kilo potatis and tre flaskor juice. Countable foods often take a plural: två äpplen, sex bananer, åtta korvar.

examples.fi: Jag vill ha ett kilo potatis och två påsar äpplen.
examples.en: I would like one kilo of potatoes and two bags of apples.
examples.note: The quantity comes before the food.

examples.fi: Vad kostar osten? Den kostar åtta euro.
examples.en: How much is the cheese? It costs eight euros.

sections.memoryTip: Picture the package: burk, påse, paket or flaska.
sections.tryIt: Make a four-item picnic list aloud.

activity.label: Build quantities
activity.title: Match food to a useful quantity
activity.instructions: Make natural shopping-list chunks, then say them.

sections.title: Numbers and order numbers
body: Counting numbers answer how many: tjugo, fyrtiotvå, hundra. An ordinal number gives a place in order: första, andra, tredje. Dates use order numbers too: den elfte maj.

Build larger numbers from the parts: 21 tjugoett, 42 fyrtiotvå, 100 hundra, 125 hundratjugofem, 1,000 tusen. Before an en-word, one becomes en: tjugoen personer. For a phone number, say one digit at a time.

examples.fi: Vad är ditt telefonnummer? Mitt nummer är noll fyra noll, ett två tre, fyra fem sex sju.
examples.en: What is your phone number? My number is 040 123 4567.
examples.note: An invented number for speaking practice. Say every digit, including zero.

sections.memoryTip: 14 fjorton and 40 fyrtio are easy to mix up. Say both slowly.
sections.tryIt: Say your age, house number and today's date.

activity.label: Count or order?
activity.title: Is it a quantity or a position?
activity.summary: Counting and order numbers answer different questions.

sections.title: Present your family
body: Start with the relationship, then add a name, age and home. Swedish has exact grandparent words: farmor and farfar are your father's parents; mormor and morfar are your mother's parents. Inga means no before a plural noun.

Moster is your mother’s sister and morbror her brother. Faster is your father’s sister and farbror his brother. Bror and syster become bröder and systrar. Barnfri usually describes choosing not to have children; barnlös means without children, often when that is not a choice.

examples.fi: Jag har en syster. Hon heter Priya, är trettio år och bor i Indien.
examples.en: I have a sister. Her name is Priya, she is 30 and lives in India.
examples.note: After the first sentence, hon avoids repeating min syster.

examples.fi: Jag har inga syskon, men jag har många kusiner.
examples.en: I have no siblings, but I have many cousins.

sections.memoryTip: far- points to your father's side; mor- points to your mother's side.
sections.tryIt: Present two real or invented relatives in four sentences.

activity.label: Family links
activity.title: Match the relative to the family link
activity.instructions: Pair each Swedish word with its plain meaning.
activity.pattern: far- = father's side; mor- = mother's side.

sections.title: Clock time and frequency
body: Ask Vad är klockan? Say klockan fem, kvart över fem, halv sex and kvart i sex. Halv sex is 5:30 because Swedish looks forward to six. Frequency words tell how often: alltid, ofta, ibland, sällan, aldrig.

examples.fi: Jag tränar ofta, men jag simmar sällan.
examples.en: I often exercise, but I rarely swim.
examples.note: The frequency word follows the verb here.

sections.memoryTip: At :30, name the coming hour: 17:30 = halv sex.

activity.label: Read the clock
activity.title: Match time and Swedish
activity.instructions: Match each digital time to the spoken time.
activity.pattern: över is past; i is to; halv points to the next hour.

sections.title: A short weather report
body: Many weather phrases start with det: Det regnar. Det snöar. Det är soligt. Two useful noun subjects are Solen skiner and Vinden blåser. Add a temperature with Det är tjugo grader.

examples.fi: I dag är det molnigt och kallt. Det blåser lite.
examples.en: Today it is cloudy and cold. It is a little windy.
examples.note: One short sentence per weather fact.

examples.fi: I morgon blir det soligt och varmt.
examples.en: Tomorrow it will be sunny and warm.

sections.memoryTip: Use det for regnar, snöar and är; use solen or vinden when you name them.
sections.tryIt: Look outside and give a three-sentence report.

activity.label: Weather report
activity.title: Match each weather phrase
activity.instructions: Pair the Swedish report with its meaning.
activity.pattern: Learn each weather report as a whole chunk.

assignment.title: Lecture 10 mission: My family and a picnic
assignment.instructions:
CORE: Present two or three people in your family. Give their names, ages and where they live. Add one thing you often do together.

WRITE: Invite a friend to a picnic. Include day, time, place, food to bring and weather.

RETURN: Present two people from memory in under 30 seconds.
assignment.model: Jag vill berätta om min familj. Jag har en syster som heter Priya. Hon är trettio år och bor i Indien. Dessutom har jag en bror som heter Rohan. Han är tjugosju år och bor i Indien. Vi pratar ofta i telefon.

takeaways: Build a shopping quantity with a container or weight: två påsar äpplen, ett kilo ost.
Use counting numbers for ages and prices; use ordinal numbers for order and dates.
Present family with relationship, name, age and home.
Remember that halv sex is 5:30, and learn weather reports as whole chunks.
